en.content:
If the sum and product of the first three term in
an A.P. are 33 and 1155, respectively, then a value
of its 11<sup>th</sup> term is :-
en.explanation:
Let the three terms are a - d, a, a + d

Given a - d + a + a + d = 33

3a = 33

a = 11

Also given,

(a - d)a(a + d) = 1155

(a2 - d2)a = 1155

(112 - d2)11 = 1155

(112 - d2) = 105

d = 4

When d = 4 and a = 11 then series is

7, 11, 15, ....

T11 = a + 10d = 7 + 10 4 = 47

When d = -4 and a = 11 then series is

15, 11, 7, ....

T11 = a + 10d = 15 + 10 -4 = -25
